summary.text: Drew Roach is a Republican member of the Minnesota House of Representatives from District 58B, in office since 2025, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Democrat Ed Fellows is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Drew Roach was born in Burnsville, Minnesota, and graduated from Burnsville High School.
His career experience includes working as a business owner.
Roach's 2025-2026 committee assignments included the Education Policy Committee, Elections Finance and Policy and the House Taxes Committee.
